decision.reason: [ev-bca50902f293] is only a table-of-contents link under "Removed features". It names the feature but links to a section that is not included here. It doesn't say what the feature is (for example, which Composition mode or field), which environments use it, or what happens to an un-migrated environment after upgrading. The body of the linked "#native-patch-and-transform-composition" section in the upgrade guide is needed before anyone can write the applicability and consequence aspects.
